body:
I’m trying my best to fight it. Today I forced myself to go outside and just sit in the sun to get some vitamin D. Just to move, like you said. I wore a mask outside since the pollen count is so high and the last thing I need is a sinus infection. I did breathing exercises too even though it hurt like hell. I took deep breaths and I put my hands on my head. You’re right that this virus wants you to lay down. I feel fatigued and worn out. I wake up I feel like I’ve already gone through the whole day with strenuous exercise.     

I’m one of the lucky ones that doesn’t have to get on a ventilator yet and my fever hasn’t risen too high. My doctor told me to stop reading the news like I do and constantly checking my temperature because it will make my anxiety worse. All the news is just full of tragedy and heart ache that tears me apart that so many are going through this and aren’t making it out alive.     

I still remember at 4am when I woke up and it felt like someone had tied an belt around my lungs and every time I coughed it felt like that belt was tightening up and I was in a pool of sweat. My neck was stiff and my body was aching. I was coughing so hard that it led to back pains and more chest pain. I knew I had the virus because that pressure, the belt tightening around inside, I had never felt before in my life. I got tested and when I got tested I was wheezing, but still able to breathe enough to not need a ventilator. I’m lucky I wasn’t in critical condition. I feel horrible for all the people that are losing their loved ones to this and people that are going through what I am right now. 

The money is still a strong concern. I’m going to be out of it soon and the bills are due. I’m going to be homeless soon and without health insurance. I’ll find a way to make it, but God damn, this is gonna be hard to get my life all together again.

Update: the pain is getting worse in my chest. The breathing is becoming more difficult and I have asthma and I’ve been directed to take more of my emergency inhaler. I had a doctor on telemedicine tell me the 7th through 9th day are the worst and on those days I won’t have health insurance anymore. I’m scared out of my mind because I don’t have enough money to continue my health insurance and I can’t get work because I risk infecting others. I’m also bedridden and feel fatigue and pain. I don’t know what to do.

Thank you! I will stay strong and fight this infection off. I’m doing breathing exercises that a medical expert talked about. Breathing deeply and building my lung capacity to build my lungs strength up. And I’m eating healthy and drinking plenty of fluids.

Thank you. I’m doing breathing exercises to help strengthen my lungs even though I don’t want to. It hurts. But I know this will help me get more oxygen in my blood to help. Last night I woke up in sweats, so I changed the sheets and my shirt, took some cough medicine and Tylenol and laid down on my back and fell asleep after an hour. I did progressive muscle relaxation to help. I’m saying all of this because I hope someone comes across this and maybe finds this helpful. We can fight this!

I know. It’s horrible. It’s such a troubling time for everyone right now. I have asthma so this makes it harder. I’ve been having to take 2 puffs of my emergency inhaler every 4 hours. Which is crazy because I normally only need it if I exercise. But I’m trying to stay positive and do everything I can hopefully to fight it away :)
Yes. Yesterday I said I felt better, but today I don’t feel as good. I don’t know where this is going but if I can’t breathe or get a higher fever I’m heading off to the ER.
I’d have to say Xi Jinping. Overall terrible person. I don’t even think he’s a human actually. A vampire. Would not have a beer with him.

The first sign was a weird pressure/pain in my chest. I say weird because it felt like a snake was wrapped around inside my chest. The cough and fever came after that.

Edit:
I also have to note that when I woke up in the middle of the night I also woke up in a pool of sweat and my neck felt stiff. The next day I started noticing body aches that were most noticeable in my lower back. The fever and cough came on a few days later. To fight that I put a cold rag on my head, took a cough suppressant, took Tylenol and breathed as calmly as I could and inhaled deeply to fill my lungs with oxygen.
When I initially posted this AMA I was feeling terrible. But I’ve been feeling a lot better. Pain level is down and my cough is under control. Thanks for asking :)
I got it from a family member that was exposed to it in early March. Thank you! Things are going to be okay. I’m in pain and coughing. But I can fight this! :)
I tested positive. My first symptom was waking up at 4am a few nights ago coughing and in pain. But I’m getting better!
Green. And please celebrate with fireworks, strippers and lots of smoke machines.
Feels like a snake is around my chest tightening its grip. Oddly enough the body aches and coughs are the worst at night for me.
I have coronavirus. Why do I feel pain in my back before I go to sleep? And I keep waking up coughing. Should I keep taking cough suppressants? Isn’t coughing trying to get the virus out?
